answer_1.quote: The brain-to-text decoding task seeks to build a decoding model that reconstructs natural language text from brain signals, with the goal of accurately decoding what the subject hears.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text from brain signals

answer_2.quote: BLEU  and ROUGE ) are applied to measure the decoding performance. BLEU measures the n-gram overlap between decoded content and ground truth. ROUGE-N comparing the consistency of N-grams between the decoded content and the ground truth.
